description: Image Description: The image shows a white microwave oven with a windowed door. Attached to the door is a white, fluffy, faux fur decoration that resembles a face with two black and white circular eyes and a nose. The fur extends downwards, giving an appearance similar to a beard. The microwave's control panel is visible on the right side with various buttons and a digital display showing the time "10:16." The background includes wooden cabinetry.
